prerequisites: Knowledge of machine elements (shafts, axles, screws, couplings, gears)

learning_outcomes.text: Students will have advanced knowledge of computer-aided design that goes significantly beyond the mere operation of a CAD system.

Students can actively shape the design process, perform calculations for all relevant machine elements with professional software tools. In parallel, participants can create geometric models of complex assemblies in CAD and iteratively perform optimizations in conjunction with calculations.
Students can question and verify the constructive design.
Students create a complete design, consisting of a requirements list, concepts, design, and digital model.
Students work in groups to develop solutions for scientific problems and present the results using meaningful documents.

syllabus_topics: Design as an optimization and design process
Manufacturing- and function-oriented design in CAD for cast and welded components
Structuring the model by using multiple bodies
Design and calculation of the machine elements used with relevant software
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a term paper. For this term paper, constructions of 1-2 assemblies including calculations must be carried out.
